audit.why: Even-to-slightly-favoured lane (52.22% WR, 2909 games). Early poke edge to Syndra, Aurora threatens once W engage + passive sustain come online. Existing diff EVEN 5.5/10 is consistent.
Spikes: Syndra lvl 2 QE, lvl 6 execute R, Luden's; Aurora lvl 6 Between Worlds and W-engage windows. Chart shows Syndra-lean throughout, matching packet levelChart (all Syndra) and win rate.

audit.whatIsWrong: Content layer repeatedly calls Aurora's engage 'Across the Sand (E)' — fabricated name and wrong slot. Her dash/stealth is Across the Veil (W, 22/21/20/19/18s); her E, The Weirding, is a slow blast that hops her BACKWARD, not a dash-in. Her Q is Twofold Hex (9s rank 1, projectile, recast return). Passive Spirit Abjuration heals — anti-heal relevant (missingInteractions). breakdown.cooldowns had no numbers.
audit.why: Kit file is authoritative: W is the only forward mobility outside R Between Worlds (140/120/100s).
audit.corrected: All 'Across the Sand' / 'E dash-in' references rewritten to Across the Veil (W) hop-in; real cooldowns added; Oblivion Orb note added for her passive healing.

edits.before: From 3 your QE stun is a hard answer to her Across the Sand dash — the instant she blinks in, lock her out of the air and chunk her before she can combo.
